name: Lena Price
life: “I still remember the first neighbor who trusted me to witness a signature.” People around the brick passage off the shop row know Lena by a small Sunday habit. Lena takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I agreed to work half the shift so my neighbor could take her citizenship oath. I am the one she asked to witness it.
appearance: Lena has a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Look for short copper curls. Off duty, the familiar outfit is a black overshirt with pearl buttons with a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining. In conversation Lena leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Lena gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Lena privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To witness the neighbor's citizenship oath.
family: Victor Armas is Lena’s half-sibling. Lena asks before bringing somebody along. Victor can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The empty chair on nights*, Victor says, “I borrowed her spare trainers on my first night.”
connections: Ben Ortiz. The language exam and the citizenship oath need cover on the same Saturday.

reactions.situation: A family member asks for a definite promise about Saturday
reactions.response: Lena promises a definite check-in time even if the watch itself is still uncertain.

reactions.situation: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop
reactions.response: Lena lets the child choose whether to stand by the door or sit beside the window while another adult gets help.

reactions.response: Lena offers one private chance to correct it before the next conversation.
